column1: # Bench checks, one per predicted-fault refusal (RUL-18), moved here from TVI-WO-0100b.FEEDBACK.md §1 (B1-B4) by
# TVI-WO-1200. Each runs on NUCLEO-H753ZI SPI1 with its kernel clock on, from reset, and reads back what silicon did.
# tools/tviburi-release reads this file into the ledgers bench rows. Tab-separated, nine columns, none empty:
# guard, id, rule, bit (as the refusal names it), procedure, confirms (the result that confirms the kind), refutes,
# citation (RM0433 Rev 9), result ("not run" until it is run on silicon).

column5: TVI-WO-1300a (5), which reading holds: from reset (HSI the system clock), PLLSRC = 00 (HSI), PLL1ON, wait PLL1RDY; leave CFGR.SW at HSI; switch the system clock to HSE (HSEON, wait HSERDY, SW = 010, wait SWS = 010); clear HSION; read RCC_CR

column7: HSIRDY = 0: section 8.5.2 (p340-342) holds, and PLL1 loses its reference

column8: DS12117 Rev 10 Table 8 p68 (LQFP144: -), Figure 6 p57; RM0433 Rev 9 §11.4.1 p541

column5: the dma tcm firmware on NUCLEO-H753ZI: DMA1EN; AXI SRAM 0x24000000 filled, a DTCM word at 0x20000400 written 0; DMA1 stream 0 memory-to-memory (PAR = 0x24000000, M0AR = 0x20000400, NDT = 4, words, both increments), EN; then read DMA_LISR, DMA_S0CR and 0x20000400
column6: the destination word unchanged; expected from memory, not read in RM0433: TEIF0 set and EN cleared by the bus error (p665 names "a transfer error on the AHB master buses")

column6: a mismatched CRC, or a HardFault or BusFault: data fetched with too few wait states is wrong (from memory: RM0433 says only that LATENCY "must be correctly programmed")

column4: BRR, CR1.M0/PCE/FIFOEN or CR2.RXINV changed with UE = 1 (the ChibiOS re-init pattern, acknowledged by name)
column5: (ruled 2026-11-24T18:55Z Q2 (c), priority; FIFOEN added 19:13Z) on NUCLEO-H753ZI, USART3 (the ST-LINK VCP) at 115200 baud, 8N1, FIFOEN = 0, UE = TE = RE = 1, receiving a continuous byte stream from the host. With UE = 1 mid-reception, as ChibiOS usart_init does on an enabled port, write in turn and read back after each: (a) BRR for 9600 baud, then send 0x55 and capture TX, and receive at 9600; (b) CR1 with M0 = PCE = 1 (8E1), then send 0x55 and capture its frame; (c) CR1 with FIFOEN = 1, then receive 20 bytes unread and read ISR.RXFF and the count RDR returns; (d) CR2 with RXINV = 1, then receive from an inverted source
column6: each write is taken: the register reads the new value and the line behaves by it (9600 baud; an 8E1 frame; a 16-deep FIFO; inverted reception), as the twin takes it; the expectation is field evidence, from memory: thousands of H7 flight controllers change baud and framing this way
column7: a write is ignored (the old value reads back, or the line keeps the old baud, framing, FIFO or polarity) or reception garbles: that field's acknowledgement is wrong and its change becomes a refusal
column8: RM0433 Rev 9 §48.8.5 p2082 (BRR), §48.8.1 p2067 (FIFOEN), p2069 (M0, PCE), §48.8.3 p2075 (RXINV): each "can only be written when the USART is disabled (UE = 0)"; TVI-WO-1305.measure.md §2.1

column4: a start with BRR = 0, then BRR rewritten (ArduPilot's measured start, acknowledged by name)
column5: (ruled 2026-11-24 at TVI-WO-1305's merge, Q2; TVI-WO-1305a.measure.md §1) on NUCLEO-H753ZI, USART3 (the ST-LINK VCP), kernel clock rcc_pclk1 at a known frequency, FIFOEN = 0, a logic analyser on TX (PD8) and on RX driven by the host. (a) As ArduPilot does: BRR = 0, CR2 = 0x40, CR3 = 0x1, CR1 = 0x12D (UE, RE, TE); then CR1 = 0, CR2 = 0, CR3 = 0; the same start again; then, with UE = 1, BRR for 115200 baud and CR1 = 0x2000013D. Read back BRR after each write. Then send 0x55 and capture TX, and receive 0x55 from the host at 115200. (b) The same start with BRR = 0 held for 1 s, the host sending 0x55 at 115200 throughout: read ISR (RXNE, ORE, FE, NE) and RDR, and capture TX while TDR = 0x55 is written
column6: from memory, not a page: (a) BRR reads 0x271 after the rewrite and the line runs at 115200 both ways, as the twin takes it; (b) silicon receives nothing usable while BRR = 0 (errors or no RXNE) and TX is not a 115200 frame
column7: BRR still reads 0 after the rewrite with UE = 1, or the line keeps no baud until the next start with UE = 0 (as p2082's "only when UE = 0" reads): the acknowledgement then covers a second of BRR = 0 on silicon (0.2017-1.2038 s in ArduPilot's armed run, in which nothing moved), and a byte that arrives in it would be lost; (b) a byte received or sent at some baud: the twin's refusal of a byte in the held start stands, and its condition text is corrected
column8: RM0433 Rev 9 §48.5.7 p2035 ("USARTDIV must be greater than or equal to 16"; "The baud counters are updated to the new value in the baud registers after a write operation to USART_BRR"), §48.8.5 p2082 (BRR "can only be written when the USART is disabled (UE = 0)"); TVI-WO-1305a.measure.md §1
